paragraphs.text: Trokair was a city of Icatia , on the continent of Sarpadia on the plane of Dominaria .

Trokair was an Icatian city led by mayor Lydia Wynforth . The citizens and troops of Trokair long held out against the goblin and orc forces before being destroyed. The city's destruction caused the Farrelites to break away from Icatia as a whole. The Flagstones of Trokair would stand for millennia following the city's destruction.
